related_questions.question: Can I pay off my St George personal loan early?
related_questions.snippet: Yes, you can. You won't be penalised for paying extra, and it can reduce the overall interest you'll pay. Just note if you fully repay the loan within the first 12 months, there's a $150 Loan discharge fee. This decreases to $100 if you fully repay after the first 12 months but before the end of the loan term.

related_questions.question: What credit score is required to get a personal loan?
related_questions.snippet: You'll typically need a credit score of at least 580 to qualify for a personal loan, but the higher your score, the more affordable your loan rate. Lenders want to see that loan applicants have a history of responsibly paying debt, and your credit score provides a window into your past behavior.

related_questions.question: How much are payments on a $20,000 personal loan?
related_questions.snippet: The monthly payment on a $20,000 loan ranges from $273 to $2,009, depending on the APR and how long the loan lasts. For example, if you take out a $20,000 loan for one year with an APR of 36%, your monthly payment will be $2,009.
